behaviour: POST /orders/bulk-cancel accepts a list of order IDs and cancels each eligible order.
An empty list of order IDs must return 400.
Stock is restored only for orders that were actually cancelled by this request.
Orders that are not in 'placed' status are silently skipped during bulk cancel.
Only the user who created an order may read, modify, or cancel it.
Cancelling an order restores the stock of each item to its pre-order level.
Only placed orders can be cancelled; any other status returns 400.
